text_block_list.text:
Today is the Fan Appreciation Festival. 
The academy opens its doors for various 
events to deepen the bond with the fans.

Winning Ticket's extensive all-around 
athletic experience was recognized, and 
she was selected as a representative 
player for volleyball.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: My position is libero! I'm so nervous~~~!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Diving all out to save any 
ball that comes your way— it's such a cool 
and vital position!

text_block_list.name: Ticket's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah! It's Ticketzo! You're playing in 
volleyball, right!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Are you one of my fans!? Yes, yes, 
that's right--!!

text_block_list.name: Ticket's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Wah, I can't wait! I'll be there to cheer 
you on!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, thank youuu!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All our fans are coming to watch! I'll do 
my best to make it the greatest match 
ever!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Let's do thiiisss!
And so, the match began.

Winning Ticket dashed all over the court 
at full power, making a huge contribution 
to her team.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Toryaryaryaryaryaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Teammate
text_block_list.text: Nice receive, Ticket!

"The battle intensified, culminating in a 
fierce clash where Winning Ticket's side 
was just one point away from victory!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Alright, one more set!

text_block_list.name: Teammate
text_block_list.text: Let's get fired up!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah!!

Neither side scored easily, and the rally 
dragged on— until the opposing team 
unleashed a sharp spike.

text_block_list.name: Teammate
text_block_list.text: Please, Ticket!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Uggghhh... I lost...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
If only I'd caught that ball, we might 
have won...!!

text_block_list.name: Teammate
text_block_list.text:
It's a team race, Ticket, so it's not your 
fault! If anything, you really helped us 
out!

text_block_list.name: Teammate
text_block_list.text:
"Plus, Ticket's energy caught on, and got 
me super pumped up too!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uuuuugh! What wonderfully kind teammates I 
haveee!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: THANK YOUUUU!! WAAAAAAHHH!!

Though they lost the match... it seemed 
they were able to spend a truly memorable 
day.

text_block_list.name: Ticket's Fan A
text_block_list.text: Hang in there, Ticket-zo!

text_block_list.name: Ticket's Fan B
text_block_list.text: Nice guts! You can totally win this!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ...! Everyone, my fans!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Allllriiiight...!

Neither side scored easily, and the rally 
dragged on— until the opposing team 
unleashed a sharp spike.

text_block_list.name: Ticket's Fans
text_block_list.text: Go, Ticket-zoooo!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: —Uryaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaay!! I wonnnn!!

text_block_list.name: Ticket's Fans
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Teammate
text_block_list.text:
You're today's MVP, Ticket! Way to squeeze 
through such a tight gap!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! Hearing all the fans cheering for 
me made me super determined to take the 
win~!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Thanks for your suppoooort!

Winning Ticket's sparkling smile was met 
with thunderous applause from the 
audience.
